[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 27::Three years.
]


For compensation for breach of a promise to do anything at a specified time, or upon the happening of a specified contingency.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the time specified arrives or the contingency happens.
